global: This is miso ramen, its broth a rich, creamy yellow. Topped with chashu pork, nori, and green onions, it sits in a white bowl with black rim, resting on a warm wooden table under soft, ambient light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle scratches.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with black rim and "萬珍軒" characters, smooth surface, slightly chipped edge.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth, creamy yellow, smooth surface with visible noodle strands and green onion garnish.
regions.spoon: Black spoon with smooth, glossy surface, slightly tapered handle, rounded bowl, and subtle reflective highlights.
regions.seaweed: Nori seaweed, dark green with black speckles, has a rough, irregular shape and slightly curled edges.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, thinly sliced with pinkish-white center, browned edges, and visible marbling.
